description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 25.04.2022 to 01.05.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it is issued by a government official (the Director General of Customs), the content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities, so government classification types (1-3) do not apply.
